approval_ref: Reference Trunk Tools and let users ask questions answered from existing project files.
notes: Reproduce a dimension borrowed from another exact RFI in the same citation.
Bind non-identifier numbers in ordinary answers and source findings to one exact RFI/Submittal statement or one unique matching locator.
Preserve comparison summaries by validating each source finding independently before combining them.
Make no provider request, dependency, vector store, unit/property inference, arithmetic or source-authority rule.
title: Scope numeric values to workflow identities
objective: Prevent a dimension, quantity or other numeric value from moving between exact RFI/Submittal items in one project-file answer scope.
